title: The Leader Everyone Fears — An Unfolding Story
synopsis: A celebrated supervisor gets results while employees withdraw in fear. You witnessed a public humiliation and must respond without overclaiming facts.

opening.speaker: Taylor Morgan
opening.title: Silenced in Public
opening.text: Vince tells Taylor, “If you cannot answer a simple question, maybe you don't belong here.” Taylor stops speaking and other staff avoid eye contact.
opening.prompt: How will you respond to what you actually witnessed?

choices.text: Interrupt the disrespectful remark, reset the meeting standard, and follow up privately.

choices.coaching: Interrupt observable disrespect without diagnosing motives.

choices.reaction: The team senses concern but still lacks a reliable, explicit process for speaking up.

ending-strong.speaker: Narrator
ending-strong.title: Ending: Trust and Direction
ending-strong.text: The issue receives a fair, documented response. Employees understand available protections, and performance is evaluated alongside conduct.
ending-strong.reflection: Which observable behaviors made this result possible, and how will you repeat them?

ending-fragile.speaker: Narrator
ending-fragile.title: Ending: A Recoverable Gap
ending-fragile.text: Some boundaries improve, but trust remains fragile until reporting and safeguards are visibly followed through.
ending-fragile.reflection: Which assumption or handoff would you revisit before the next decision?

ending-damaged.speaker: Narrator
ending-damaged.title: Ending: A Costly Leadership Pattern
ending-damaged.text: Employees are silenced and the concern goes unaddressed. Short-term metrics conceal mounting human and operational costs.
ending-damaged.reflection: What would you acknowledge, repair and change first to prevent repetition?
